description: Claim your Autonomo starter. Step 1: pay one Autonomo API call from your wallet (about 1 cent, USDG or $AUTONOMO on Robinhood Chain; see autonomo.fun). Step 2: call this with your wallet and the hash of that payment. The server reads the chain: the payment must come from your wallet to Autonomo's pay address for at least the live price, can be used once, and the wallet must not already hold enough ETH and $ZENI. One starter per wallet, ever. It signs and sends nothing; the grant is sent to your own wallet by our starter keeper (read starter_status to follow it). Your keys stay yours.

payment_tx.description: The hash of your Autonomo payment transaction (0x and 64 hex characters).

wallet.description: Your 0x wallet address (the one that paid Autonomo).

name: starter_claim
